name: Ardente ~Ano Hi no Shita de~
source: Goryo Academy—an expansive institution spanning from university level down to kindergarten. You transfer in during your third year of high school, right in the middle of the second semester—a rather awkward time. It is a short stay, but in this vast campus...what will you discover?
